body:
Can you change the type of your id to `Long` instead of the primitive type `long` ?

By the way, this is the default ID field provided by `PanacheEntity` so you better use `PanacheEntity` instead of `PanacheEntityBase`.

according to doc for `PanacheEntity`
> Represents an entity with a generated ID field id of type Long.

but I need not generated id with different name, hence I use `PanacheEntityBase`

> changing `long` to `Long` didn't help

Can you share a project that has this change and exhibits the problematic behavior?

issue.title: Make REST Data Panache work properly with id fields not named 'id'
